title: When LLMs Enter Everyday Feminism on Chinese Social Media: Opportunities and Risks for Women’s Empowerment

bias_targets.methodology: Feminist Critical Discourse Analysis (FCDA) of DeepSeek-generated responses shared on Chinese social media, utilizing Kabeer's framework of women's empowerment to qualitatively code and evaluate how the LLM frames women's achievements, agency, and pathways, particularly assessing whether the outputs adapt to or challenge existing patriarchal structures.

Qualitative analysis of the material and financial resources presupposed by the LLM's advice, revealing underlying assumptions of class privilege, meritocracy, and the framing of economic disadvantage as a personal failure rather than a structural limitation.
